title: Bouncing Ball
description: Interactive simulation demonstrating basic physics concepts of motion, velocity, and collision detection. Features a ball bouncing within boundaries with user-controllable speed parameter.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Physics
Motion
Velocity
Collision Detection
Kinematics
learningObjectives: Explain how the ball's position is updated each frame by adding a velocity component to its x and y coordinates
Predict the direction the ball travels after the speed slider is moved to a new value
Describe the boundary-detection test that compares the ball's edge against the drawing region and reverses the sign of the velocity component on contact
Identify the separation between the drawing region and the control region, and the role of the speed slider in that control area
Explain how updateCanvasSize() and windowResized() keep the sketch responsive to the width of its container
